sentences.text:
Deputy Collector , Collectorate Pathanamthitta, Pin - 689645
 Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances
stated in the affidavit filed along with the Wp(C) the High Court be
pleased to stay the acquisition proceedings in connection with the
widening of Kuppakkara-Vattamon Road for Konni Medical Collage, over the
land comprised in Re.Survey No.79/17 of Iravon Village, Konny Taluk ,
owned and possessed by the petitioner pending final disposal of this writ
petition.

This petition coming on for orders upon perusing the petition and the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and upon hearing the arguments of SRI.AJEESH K.SASI, Advocate for the petitioner and of GOVERNMENT PLEADER for respondents, the court passed the following:
 T.R. RAVI, J.
 --------------------------------------------
 W.P.(C). Nos.44618 & 43743 of 2024  --------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 7th day of January, 2025  ORDER
When these cases are taken up, the counsel for the petitioners submits that possession is being taken even without payment of compensation.
Government Pleader seeks time to get instructions.
